name: Agent Adapter Confidence
description: An evidence-derived assessment for an adapter revision, observed agent build or surface revision, operation and machine/configuration scope. A dated assessment may be retained; its current applicability must be rechecked. Display order is not an assurance ordering or dispatch permission. Confidence never strengthens an observed outcome or grants consent.

values.label: Unknown
values.description: Available evidence is insufficient to derive a current assessment. This is not a claim that qualification never occurred.

values.label: Grey: never qualified
values.description: The assessed adapter/surface has no qualification baseline in the declared evidence scope, or no adapter exists.

values.label: Red: known broken
values.description: Applicable evidence demonstrates failure of a required operation or compatibility check. Missing observations alone do not establish breakage.

values.label: Orange: drift or stale evidence
values.description: A baseline exists, but a relevant contract/configuration change is detected or its qualification/freshness conditions no longer hold. This is not proof of breakage.

values.label: Yellow: untested, no detected drift
values.description: The current build is unqualified, but a declared comparable contract matches a qualified baseline and current required canaries pass. Missing contract evidence or a small version increment alone is insufficient.

values.label: Green: qualified
values.description: Qualification covers the exact adapter and observed build/surface revision, required operation and configuration/platform scope; required current canaries and freshness conditions hold.

examples.dataset: required operation qualified for the current adapter, build and configuration with current canaries
new unqualified build with matching comparable contract and passing current canaries
